title: 230쪽 · Floating to Overbet
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Pro tip: It’s best to overbet rivers against severely capped ran ges
$5-$10NL: The Button raises to $30. Hero calls.
Here's a line that’s been gaining popularity.
Hero checks. Villain bets $30. Hero calls.

Hero's check-call is multipurpose on this board. He has six pair + OESD Outs that are probably good if Villain checks the turn. He has six clean and two dirty straight outs. There are 10 Spades that give him a ton of equity: There are also 11 clubs in the deck that he could potentially represent on turns and rivers. There’s so much opportunity.
